BEGIN_SIGNATURE:M109
@HasFDerivAt.clm_apply : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField.{u_1} 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_2} E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace.{u_1, u_2} 𝕜 E] {G : Type u_4} [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_4} G]
  [inst_4 : NormedSpace.{u_1, u_4} 𝕜 G] {x : E} {H : Type u_5} [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_5} H]
  [inst_6 : NormedSpace.{u_1, u_5} 𝕜 H] {c : E → ContinuousLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_4, u_5} (RingHom.id.{u_1} 𝕜) G H}
  {c' :
    ContinuousLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_2, max u_5 u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_1} 𝕜) E
      (ContinuousLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_4, u_5} (RingHom.id.{u_1} 𝕜) G H)}
  {u : E → G} {u' : ContinuousLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_1} 𝕜) E G},
  HasFDerivAt.{u_1, u_2, max u_4 u_5} c c' x →
    HasFDerivAt.{u_1, u_2, u_4} u u' x →
      HasFDerivAt.{u_1, u_2, u_5} (fun y => (c y) (u y))
        (HAdd.hAdd.{max u_2 u_5, max u_2 u_5, max u_2 u_5}
          (ContinuousLinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} (c x) u')
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.flip.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} c') (u x)))
        x
BEGIN_AXIOMS:M109
'HasFDerivAt.clm_apply' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice.{u}, Quot.sound.{u}]
